The test image shows a soybean leaf with:
- Broad interveinal yellowing/chlorosis (tan-yellow background)
- Scattered dark brown/purple spots throughout the yellowed area
- More severe on the right portion of the leaf

Top candidates: Sudden_death_syndrome (interveinal chlorosis + necrosis), Septoria_brown_spot (scattered brown spots), Cercospora (angular spots with yellow halos). Let me view references.
The Septoria_brown_spot reference (top-left) shows yellow leaves with scattered dark brown/purple spots — very similar to the test image. Let me check a few more candidates to be thorough.
The Frogeye bottom-right panel also shows yellow leaf with dark spots — similar. Let me check a few more candidates.
The Phyllosticta top-left also shows yellow leaf with scattered dark spots. Let me check a few more to finalize.

Now I have enough evidence to make my assessment.

**Key observations from test image:**
- Broad yellowing/chlorosis covering most of the leaf (tan-yellow background)
- Numerous scattered small-to-medium dark brown/purple spots distributed throughout the yellowed area
- More severe on the right/tip portion of the leaf
- No distinct spot borders or gray centers (rules out frogeye)

**Comparison summary:**
- **Septoria_brown_spot** (top-left panel): Yellow leaves with many scattered dark brown/purple spots — **very strong match** to the test image pattern
- **Bacterial_Pustule** (bottom-left panel): Scattered brown-red spots on yellowing leaves — somewhat similar but spots appear more blotchy/irregular
- **Phyllosticta**: Spots concentrated in yellow zone, fewer in number
- **Sudden_death_syndrome**: More defined interveinal chlorosis with distinct green veins remaining
- **Cercospora**: Darker purple blotches rather than scattered individual spots on yellow background
- **Frogeye**: Circular spots with gray centers — not matching
- **Anthracnose/Diaporthe**: Primarily pod/stem damage

The Septoria_brown_spot reference collage top-left panel shows a nearly identical presentation: yellow leaf with numerous small scattered dark brown/purple spots uniformly distributed — this is the closest match to the test image.
